readings: What are the top 10 observatory stations (`observstation`) by share of all telescopes? For each one, show the station, how many telescopes it has, and its share of the total telescope count, without rounding, ordered from the largest share down.
queries:
SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share
FROM observatories AS o
LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY telescope_share DESC
LIMIT 10
